# VESSL

> VESSL (Strength in Motion) is a UK fitness coaching brand offering structured training and nutrition programs that fit real life. Delivered online via PT Distinction.

## Programs
- [8-Week Summer Shred](https://vessl-ltd.co.uk/summer-shred): An 8-week structured fat-loss and lean-muscle program to get beach-body ready for summer. One-time price of £55, yours to keep and reuse. Includes 8 weeks of structured training, easy-to-follow workouts, and nutrition guidance. For anyone wanting to get lean, busy professionals needing structure, and anyone after beach-ready confidence. No crash diets, no guesswork.
